entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I need to return something. This VeloBand sensor thing. I'm just so confused by the website and the policies.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the VeloBand? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, no, it's not broken or anything. I haven't even opened it. It's just... we had a family emergency right after it was delivered. My father had to be rushed to the hospital.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope he's doing alright.

He's recovering now. He needed unexpected surgery, so it's been a lot. With all that going on, I completely forgot about this package. I think I'm past the return date? I'm so overwhelmed. Can't you just help me?
I completely understand, and I'm sorry you had to go through that. Let me see what I can do. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, I have it here. It's VF-9942-18B.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It was delivered 35 days ago, on December 15th.
See, I knew it was too late. I just have no use for it now.
Please hold on one moment while I check our active return policy for you... Okay, I've just checked the system. You are actually well within the return period.
I am? But... I thought it was only a few days.

Not at all. Our policy states that all items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery, as long as they are in their original condition. Since yours is still in the box, you're perfectly fine.
Oh, wow! Are you sure? That's a huge relief. Thank you so much.

Of course. It's the least we can do. I've gone ahead and processed the return authorization for you. I'm sending an email with a prepaid shipping label and all the instructions right now. Do you see it?
Yes, it just came through! Alex, you've been a wonderful help. Thank you for making this so easy.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great day, and I wish your father a swift recovery.
